title: tylophora longipedunculata
intro: Tylophora longipedunculata, commonly known as Indian ipecac or tylophora, is a plant species in the family Apocynaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can be used to treat various conditions such as asthma, bronchitis, and rheumatism. The therapeutic actions of Tylophora longipedunculata include inhibiting the release of histamine, which can help alleviate symptoms of allergies and asthma. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
